headline.text: L1 S1 checkweigher malfunctioned during rework — maintenance troubleshooting, *line status unknown* at window close.

summary: One active food-safety equipment issue (L1 S1 checkweigher), one quality flag (L1 S4 extended cook time), and two sanitation concerns (L1 drain overflow resolved, IMS standing water flagged). L3 MFM ran wrong centerline for 2 days; L3 flow-wrap hold expanded after unlabeled rolls discovered.

holds.title: Expired chocolate melting on ML1
holds.summary: Imperial reported melting chocolate with LPN that QA is aware is expired; one pallet melted per Shawn's direction, buffer tank left at 25%.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition — QA aware, only one pallet processed, no further melting authorized.

holds.title: Flow-wrap rolls — defective adhesive placement
holds.summary: Rolls placed on hold yesterday for adhesive in wrong position; today 2 additional unlabeled bags found on same pallet, inspected, and released after testing 6 partial rolls with no issues.
holds.status: Resolved — 6 partial rolls tested and ran perfectly, no defect found.

food_safety.title: S1 checkweigher malfunction during BEQ rework
food_safety.summary: Checkweigher having issues during rework operation at 09:00; maintenance called to troubleshoot, no resolution posted by window close.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance troubleshooting, line status unknown at 12:57.

quality.title: MFM — wrong centerline used 2 days
quality.summary: Incorrect centerline sheet used past 2 days on assorted product; Shawn corrected team to use 'MFM - 16.25oz Mixed Truf' at 07:41.
quality.status: Resolved — correct centerline identified and posted by 12:53.

quality.title: S4 — dry texture in candy, pieces culled
quality.summary: Very dry texture detected in candy starting from first line pause; supervisor notified, production removing affected pieces at pack.
quality.status: Open — culling ongoing, cause under investigation.

quality.title: S4 — extended cook time flagged
quality.summary: Caramel pots taking 54 minutes vs. normal 45 minutes; QA asked if adjustment or maintenance check needed.
quality.status: Open — awaiting production or maintenance review.

sanitation.title: S1 drain overflow — floor sanitization
sanitation.summary: Drain water overflowed onto S1 floor; Angelica Perez flagged at 22:05 that affected areas were dried but sanitizer not yet applied.
sanitation.status: Resolved — area sanitization completed and confirmed by 23:06 same day.

sanitation.title: IMS area — standing water, pest risk
sanitation.summary: Water leaking in IMS area and stagnant water around Trap #70 (between Wash Area #4 and main wall) flagged during pest control inspection; risk of pest activity and microbial growth.
sanitation.status: Open — flagged to facilities and production leadership, no resolution posted.

opportunities.text: Consider adding 'check drain function and dry floor' to S1 pre-shift sanitation checklist — based on today's overflow requiring mid-shift re-sanitization.
Investigate S4 cook-time drift (54 min vs. 45 min standard) and dry-texture candy issue — both flagged same shift, may share root cause in heating or ingredient moisture.

Consider adding hold-tag and labeling protocol for partial flow-wrap rolls to prevent unlabeled material mixing with active holds — based on today's discovery of 2 unmarked bags on the same pallet as yesterday's adhesive-defect hold.
Review MFM centerline posting and shift-handoff checklist — wrong centerline used 2 consecutive days before correction, suggesting gap in setup verification.
